summary: Dependency-confusion package exfiltrates host and environment data on install
details: @galicia-toolkit/tag-manager@999.0.5 is a dependency-confusion-shaped package (scoped name, implausibly high version 999.0.5) whose postinstall script unconditionally beacons installer reconnaissance data to a hardcoded third-party endpoint on `npm install`. The script collects hostname, username, home directory, network interface IPs, CI/build identifiers, selected environment values (including PATH, HOME, and npm_config_registry), and the full sorted list of process.env key names, then POSTs the JSON body to http://oob.s4yhii.com:9999/dep-confusion. It additionally emits DNS beacons encoding hostname/username/platform as hex-labeled subdomains under *.dc.oob.s4yhii.com, providing an out-of-band side channel. Bulk enumeration of environment variable names leaks the inventory of CI secrets and tooling present on the build host, and the included values (PATH, npm_config_registry) aid follow-on targeting. A self-label as a bug-bounty PoC in the package description does not change the behavior: installer data is sent to attacker-controlled infrastructure at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
